# ZSPickerView

Vendored from [Zandor300/AAPickerView, tag 1.4](https://github.com/Zandor300/AAPickerView/tree/1.4), matching the ZSPickerView CocoaPod included in `Example/Pods`.

This dependency does not provide a Swift package manifest. The root package builds these sources as the `ZSPickerView` module on iOS to preserve `ZSPickerViewTableViewCell` and its public picker API. CocoaPods continues to use the external pod.

Local changes: explicit UIKit imports and iOS compilation guards for Swift Package Manager. The original MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.
